The `orders` CLI `--amount` flag expects **integer cents**, not dollars. Passing `40` results in a $0.40 refund, not $40.00. To refund $40.00, pass `--amount 4000`.

**Why:** The skill docs at /workspace/.claude/skills/order-support say "amount in dollars" but the CLI help says "refund amount in integer cents (4000 = $40.00)". Discovered when Priya received $0.40 instead of $40.00 (order ORD-48213, 2026-10-06).

**How to apply:** Always convert dollar amounts to cents before passing to `--amount`. Multiply dollars × 100.
